messages.subject: Unite Fails By too many Cols
parts:
Hi, 

I have been using MethylKit for a quite long. But Recently I have to reinstall the package. My problem is when I want to use the unite function I have recived this error:

> meth = unite(merge.runs,destrand=F)
Error en merge.data.table(df, df2, by = c("chr", "start", "end"), suffixes = c(as.character(i -  : 
  Elements listed in `by` must be valid column names in x and y

If I look inside of the MehylRawdata I saw this:

> head(merge.runs[[9]])
data part of methylRaw have 8 columns, expected 7 columnsmethylRaw object with 6 rows
--------------
data part of methylRaw have 8 columns, expected 7 columns            id  chr   start     end strand coverage numCs numTs
1 chr1.3003885 chr1 3003885 3003885      +        1     1     0
2 chr1.3003899 chr1 3003899 3003899      -        2     1     1
3 chr1.3003886 chr1 3003886 3003886      -        1     1     0
4 chr1.3003898 chr1 3003898 3003898      +        1     0     1
5 chr1.3014742 chr1 3014742 3014742      -        1     0     1
6 chr1.3014612 chr1 3014612 3014612      -        1     0     1
--------------
sample.id: Control1
assembly: mm10 
context: CpG 
resolution: base

I used these data before and I had never recived this error. 
I think Could it be rowames has become to another column called "id"?. I have tried another function as filterbyCov and I have recived another error related with cols. 

Hopefully, You know the answer to that. 

Thank in advance! I look foward for your answer

Regards,

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Unite Fails By too many Cols
parts:
Thanks for using methylKit. Are your objects created by previous versions of the methylKit? We removed the "id" column to save memory. It makes a huge difference if you have a lot of samples. 

if you are using the old objects you should be able to use updateMethObject() function. I also suggest you use the development version, https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/tree/development#installation

methylKit 0.9.1
--------------

NEW FUNCTIONS AND FEATURES

* objects takes less memory and they are reorganized. updateMethObject() updates
the objects from previous versions the latest version.
